dialogue.text: [wry, building tension] Level seven is fifty million dollars. It's a quarter to four, Pruitt is back from his house call, and a guy in a hoodie and old sneakers walks up to Jess's window.
You'll want to take a number, sir.
[wry, building tension] Then she types in his name, her whole screen turns gold, and Mr. Pruitt sprints across the lobby so fast that one of his shoes flies off.
Mr. Kessler! Coffee? Lunch? Anything at all?
Of course. Our very best one.

[wry, building tension] Why is a manager sweating over a man in a hoodie? Plenty of branches hold less than a hundred million dollars in total, so Mr. Kessler alone could be half of this one. If he walks across the street, half the branch walks with him.
